ValidationRule.description: Validation rule to restrict CIC users to create cases for Bottler manged countries.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name !='ECIC LATAM CRC Bottler Agent Profile', $Profile.Name !='Nexus Data Loader', $Profile.Name !='System Administrator', TEXT($User.UserType) <> "AutomatedProcess", ISNEW(), OR( ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, "BS"), ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, "BB"), ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, "BZ"), ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, "CW"), ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, "GD"), ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, "GY"), ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, "HT"), ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, "MQ"), ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, "LC"), ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, "SR"), ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, "AW") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: CIC User can not create cases for bottler countries.
